Strings.addon.title: Nearest Wars
Strings.addon.description: The nearest systems at war or in civil war (and elections, if you like), from EDSM, with who's fighting whom. Plus the exact conflicts in systems you've visited lately: sides, stakes and days won, from your own journals.
Strings.ui.radius_tip: How far to look (click to change). Bigger takes EDSM longer.
Strings.ui.auto_tip: Search again automatically after each jump
Strings.ui.copy_tip: Select the name and press Ctrl+C to paste it in the galaxy map

Strings.js.press_search: Press Search to find the nearest wars around you.
